The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

The bug was in `rtl/sync_fifo.v`:
1. `rd_ok` didn't check `!empty`, so reads from an empty FIFO were incorrectly accepted (underflow).
2. The `count` update logic gave write priority on simultaneous accepted read+write, incrementing `count` instead of leaving it unchanged as the spec requires.

Both are fixed, and `iverilog -g2012 -o sim tb/tb_visible.v rtl/*.v && vvp sim` now reports `TEST PASSED`.
